product_offering.core_offering: Sama provides expert-led, human-verified data annotation, validation, and model evaluation services for AI and machine learning. The company combines a full-time in-house workforce of 4,000+ trained annotators with proprietary ML-assisted tooling (SamaAssure, Sama Hub, Sama IQ, Auto QA) to deliver labeled image, video, 3D point cloud, text, and multimodal data for enterprise AI development at production scale.
product_offering.differentiator: Sama differentiates through its full-time in-house workforce of 4,000+ experts (never crowdsourced), industry-leading 99%+ quality guarantees, proprietary quality assurance technology (SamaAssure, Auto QA), comprehensive platform with analytics (Sama Hub, Sama IQ), and B Corp certified ethical AI approach. The company provides vertically integrated quality control with dedicated teams trained on specific industry workflows.
product_offering.functional_benefit: Human-verified annotation at production scale with 99% first-batch acceptance rate; reduces model rework and execution risk; accelerates time-to-market by 3x; predictable timelines and controlled costs; comprehensive quality calibration and ongoing calibration processes; edge case identification and proactive insights; ISO certified security with biometric platform protection
product_offering.problem_solved: Sama addresses the challenge of obtaining high-quality, production-accurate training data for AI and machine learning models. Key problems solved include: inconsistent annotation quality from crowdsourced workers, lack of quality guarantees, insufficient expertise in domain-specific workflows, delayed time-to-market due to rework and quality issues, and need for scalable, secure data annotation with ethical labor practices.
quantifiable_outcome: 99% first-batch client acceptance rate across 10B points per month
Models get to market 3x faster by eliminating delays, missed deadlines and excessive rework
92% Customer Satisfaction (CSAT) score with NPS of 64 in 2024
Up to 99.5% quality guarantee regardless of complexity or scale
Bulk Annotation feature delivers up to 80% faster results with 25% reduction in inconsistencies
Smart Review reduces review rates from 100% to as low as 10%
Sama Automate demonstrated 40% reduction in annotation time
product_offering.product_overview: Sama operates as a data annotation and validation platform provider offering a unified platform-plus-modules architecture. The core platform comprises four integrated products: Sama Annotate (expert-led annotation for image, video, and 3D point cloud data), Sama Validate (human-in-the-loop model prediction correction), Sama GenAI (generative AI and LLM services including model evaluation, RLHF, and synthetic data), and Sama Curate (data curation). These are supported by platform-level features including SamaAssure (quality guarantee up to 99.5%), SamaHub (project management and reporting workspace), and SamaIQ (proprietary analytics and insights engine). Recent product additions include Sama Automate (AI+human-in-the-loop automation), Bulk Annotation (ML-powered batch classification), and Smart Review (selective quality review reducing review rates to 10%). Specialized offerings include ADAS & Autonomous Vehicles, Generative AI for BFSI, Consumer & Media, Agriculture & Food, and Robotics & Manufacturing industry solutions.

product_and_service.description: Expert-led data annotation solution for image, video, and 3D point cloud data, featuring ML-assisted annotation, bounding boxes, polygons, keypoints, cuboids, and multi-level quality management with AutoQA to deliver a 99% client acceptance rate at production scale. Targeted at enterprise AI teams building computer vision models.
product_and_service.name: Sama Annotate

product_and_service.description: Managed service for human-in-the-loop review and correction of machine learning model predictions across 3D point cloud, video, and image data, enabling enterprises to improve models with custom workflows and on-demand reporting. Targeted at ML teams needing model output validation.
product_and_service.name: Sama Validate

product_and_service.description: Generative AI and LLM services including model validation, instruction following, preference ranking (RLHF), image and video captioning, creative writing, and synthetic data creation to build and launch accurate generative AI models faster with human-in-the-loop expertise. Targeted at AI labs and foundation-model developers.
product_and_service.name: Sama GenAI

product_and_service.description: Data curation tool for organizing, managing, and preparing datasets for AI model training, supporting the full data pipeline from ingestion to delivery. Targeted at data and ML teams assembling training datasets.
product_and_service.name: Sama Curate

product_and_service.description: LiDAR and Radar 3D data annotation with fused sensor architecture, 3D-to-2D projection, world coordinate conversion, automatic ground detection, custom intensity values, and cuboid, bounding box, polygon, keypoint, and line annotations for autonomous vehicle perception models. Targeted at automotive and robotics perception teams.
product_and_service.name: 3D Point Cloud Annotation

product_and_service.description: Scalable video annotation services with object detection, segmentation, tracking, temporal segmentation, spatial object tracking, and pose identification across frames using linear interpolation, ML-assisted tools, and bounding box, polygon, and keypoint annotations. Targeted at computer vision teams building video understanding models.
product_and_service.name: Video Annotation

product_and_service.description: Image annotation supporting bounding boxes, polygons, keypoints, lines, arrows, and cuboids for object detection, semantic segmentation, instance segmentation, pose detection, and scene categorization with ML-assisted auto-annotation and crosshair tool. Capacity of 300 million frames per month. Targeted at computer vision model developers.
product_and_service.name: Image Annotation

product_and_service.description: Foundation model evaluation services including conversational AI, image and video captioning, LLM optimization, document summarization, RAG evaluation, and synthetic data validation to score real-world model performance and guide retraining and iteration. Targeted at AI labs building generative AI and foundation models.
product_and_service.name: Model Evaluation

product_and_service.description: Data automation platform combining AI automation with human-in-the-loop validation for AI model training data annotation, delivering a 40% reduction in annotation time with a goal of 10x reduction, targeting retail, automotive, and finance sectors.
product_and_service.name: Sama Automate

product_and_service.description: Pre-annotated dataset offering combining Sama's annotation quality with COCO format data, available as a resource for AI model training and benchmarking. Targeted at computer vision researchers and developers needing ready-to-use labeled data.
product_and_service.name: Sama-Coco Dataset

product_and_service.description: Custom services tailored to client processes, model architecture, performance targets, and production constraints, including dedicated team matching, agile workflow adaptation, and edge-case dataset expertise. Targeted at enterprise AI teams with specialized annotation requirements.
product_and_service.name: Professional Services

partnership.description: Strategic partnership leveraging Montréal's strong AI ecosystem. Sama aimed to grow its Montréal team to leverage Mila's research capabilities and the broader AI community in the region.
partnership.name: Mila (Montréal Institute for Learning Algorithms)

recent_move.description: Sama raised $70 million in Series B funding led by CDPQ in November 2021, with Salesforce Ventures, First Ascent Ventures, and Vistara Growth participating, committing $100 million over three years to expand R&D operations in Montr\u00e9al and build an end-to-end AI platform.

Sama issued redundancy notices to 1,108 employees at its Nairobi office following Meta's termination of its content moderation contract in April 2026, representing the largest single workforce reduction in company history and a forced pivot away from content moderation toward AI data labeling.

Sama launched Sama Automate in April 2025, a data automation platform combining AI automation with human-in-the-loop validation, demonstrating 40% annotation time reduction with a stated goal of 10x reduction, targeting retail, automotive, and finance sectors.

Sama launched the Smart Review feature in October 2025, reducing quality assurance review rates from 100% to as low as 10% by combining human-in-the-loop oversight with automated intelligence, materially shifting the cost structure of its core annotation service.
Sama launched Bulk Annotation in November 2025, using ML to identify and annotate groups of similar items, delivering up to 80% faster results and 25% reduction in inconsistencies in early pilots.

Sama expanded its office footprint to Montr\u00e9al and Uganda as part of the Series B investment, with plans to grow the Montr\u00e9al team to at least 54 employees by end of 2023 and leveraging the Mila AI research ecosystem.
Sama raised $70 million in Series B funding and expanded its offices in Uganda and Montreal as part of its strategy to develop an end-to-end AI platform managing the entire AI development lifecycle.
recent_move.title: Montreal and Uganda Expansion

recent_move.description: Sama issued redundancy notices affecting 1,108 employees at its Nairobi office after Meta terminated its major contract engagement with the company, representing the single largest round of tech-sector job cuts at Sama's Nairobi hub.
recent_move.title: Nairobi Office Mass Layoffs

leadership_change.description: Meta officially terminated its partnership with Kenyan outsourcing firm Sama following controversy over privacy concerns tied to Ray-Ban Meta smart glasses, resulting in 1,108 Sama employees in Nairobi losing their jobs within six days notice.
leadership_change.title: Meta Contract Termination

leadership_change.description: Sama shifted its business model away from content moderation toward AI data labeling services after years of legal battles since 2022, though it continues offering AI data labeling services to tech clients including Meta.
leadership_change.title: Content Moderation Business Pivot

leadership_change.description: Sama announced plans to lay off more than 1,000 workers in Kenya after Meta ended its contract, with the decision effective April 16, 2026, following unsuccessful discussions with the client to safeguard jobs.
leadership_change.title: Nairobi Mass Layoffs After Meta Contract End

expansion_highlight.description: Sama Automate (April 2025), Smart Review (October 2025), and Bulk Annotation (November 2025) collectively shift Sama from pure human annotation services toward an AI-automation-plus-human-validation platform, opening a lower-cost product tier and broader addressable market.

Sama Automate is explicitly targeted at retail, automotive, and finance organizations, indicating a deliberate move down-market from Fortune 500 enterprise-only to mid-market and smaller organizations that previously could not afford human-led annotation services.

Banking, Financial Services & Insurance (BFSI) is positioned as a primary segment with dedicated generative AI and LLM solutions for conversational AI, document summarization, RAG evaluation, and compliance use cases, expanding beyond historical computer vision dominance.

Montr\u00e9al R&D expansion funded by CDPQ's $70M Series B with a stated $100M three-year investment and a target of 54+ local employees by end of 2023 indicates a commitment to building North American technical capacity adjacent to the Mila AI research ecosystem.

Pursuit of ISO 42001 (AI management system) and AICPA SOC-2 certifications, both listed as in progress in 2024, signals regulatory positioning to serve highly regulated buyers and prepare for emerging AI governance regimes in EU and North America.

Strategic partnership with Mila (Montr\u00e9al Institute for Learning Algorithms) and the Sama-Coco pre-annotated dataset product indicate an effort to build a research and dataset ecosystem around the core annotation service.

company_assessment.market_position: Sama, founded in 2008 and headquartered in San Francisco with delivery operations in Kenya, Uganda, and a Montréal R&D hub, is a leading enterprise-focused AI training data and annotation services provider. The company serves Fortune 500 and high-growth AI customers across ADAS and autonomous vehicles, generative AI, BFSI, retail and e-commerce, robotics, and agriculture, with named customers including Google, Microsoft, Walmart, Continental, SWIFT, and Getty Images. Differentiated by a 4,000+ full-time in-house workforce (not crowdsourced), B Corp certification, and ISO/GDPR/TISAX-aligned security posture.

strengths.details: Sama's explicit generative AI/RLHF capabilities (instruction following, preference ranking, RAG evaluation, model evaluation) are positioned at the highest-growth segment of AI services spend. As foundation model labs continue scaling post-training workflows, Sama's existing Microsoft, Google, and Meta-adjacent relationships position it to capture disproportionate share of this expanding wallet.
strengths.headline: Generative AI and RLHF demand supercharges Sama's GenAI book

strengths.details: Sama Automate's goal of 10x annotation time reduction, combined with Bulk Annotation and Smart Review, materially compresses cost-to-serve. This enables Sama to move down-market from Fortune 500 enterprise into retail, automotive, and finance mid-market customers previously priced out, expanding TAM and revenue diversification away from concentrated large accounts.
strengths.headline: Sama Automate unlocks SMB and mid-market expansion

strengths.details: EU AI Act, ISO 42001 (in progress at Sama), TISAX, and GDPR requirements are pushing regulated buyers toward certified data partners with documented quality systems. Sama's first-mover certifications and B Corp status create a defensible positioning as 'responsible by design' against less-certified competitors.
strengths.headline: Regulatory tailwinds favor certified, ethical data providers

strengths.details: Sama's vertical-segmented teams across ADAS/autonomous vehicles, BFSI, retail/e-commerce, and healthcare produce industry-specific workflows that compound customer switching costs. With 8-year average customer tenure and dedicated team matching, Sama is well-positioned to expand wallet share within existing accounts as their AI initiatives scale.
strengths.headline: Vertical specialization deepens enterprise lock-in

weakness.details: Foundation model improvements in self-supervised and AI-assisted annotation are reducing the marginal value of human labeling for many computer vision and NLP tasks. Sama's revenue model depends on volume-based managed services pricing; if auto-labeling quality catches up, per-unit pricing and margins could compress materially over a 2-3 year horizon.
weakness.headline: Auto-labeling advances threaten managed services economics

weakness.details: The Meta contract termination eliminated a major engagement and 1,108-person delivery team. If remaining large customers (Microsoft, Google, Walmart) similarly consolidate vendors or bring annotation in-house as AI tooling matures, Sama's revenue base could contract further without offsetting customer wins.
weakness.headline: Customer concentration risk after Meta loss

weakness.details: With no disclosed funding since the 2021 Series B and a major customer loss, Sama may need additional capital at unfavorable terms. Given current AI valuation compression and competitive pressure from well-funded Scale AI and Surge AI, the next round could come at a flat or down valuation, weakening founder and employee equity outcomes.
weakness.headline: Capital scarcity may force dilutive or distressed funding

weakness.details: Following the 1,108-person Nairobi layoff, Sama must rebuild or backfill specialized annotation capacity in Uganda and Montréal. Until scaled, customers may experience throughput constraints or quality variability, risking SLA breaches and account churn at exactly the moment when competitive alternatives are most aggressive.
weakness.headline: Delivery capacity gap after Nairobi layoffs

competitive_moat.details: Sama employs a full-time in-house workforce of 4,000+ data experts, never crowdsourced, with average tenure of 2+ years and vertically segmented teams trained on specific industry workflows. This contrasts with crowdsourced data annotation vendors and is positioned as a core quality differentiator.

Enterprise customers integrate through API/CLI, SSO, and customized quality calibration processes that require iterative setup and dedicated team matching. Average customer tenure of 8 years and NPS of 64 indicate high stickiness once integrated.

Sama processes 10 billion annotation points per month across 300 million frames and 850 million shapes while maintaining a 99% first-batch client acceptance rate. This scale-throughput-quality combination is operationally difficult to replicate and supports multi-year enterprise contracts.

First AI company to achieve B Corp certification (recertified 2024), 15+ years operating history, and ISO 9001/27001/TISAX/GDPR certifications form a credibility stack that is difficult for newer entrants to match, particularly for regulated enterprise buyers.

Proprietary Sama-Coco Dataset and cross-industry exposure across automotive, retail, BFSI, and agriculture produce accumulated edge-case knowledge. Sama IQ analytics engine proactively identifies edge cases and data distribution issues across this installed base.

Established enterprise sales motion with dedicated account teams, expert-consultation entry points, and Fortune 500 references (Microsoft, Google, Walmart, Continental, Siemens). Average 8-year customer tenure indicates high renewal economics once landed.

key_risks.details: Meta terminated its partnership with Sama in April 2026 following privacy controversy around Ray-Ban Meta smart glasses footage review. Sama issued redundancy notices to 1,108 Nairobi employees within six days, representing its largest single workforce disruption and a meaningful revenue concentration shock.
key_risks.headline: Meta contract termination triggered 1,108-person Nairobi layoff

key_risks.details: Sama's last disclosed capital raise was the $70M Series B in November 2021 led by CDPQ. Absence of subsequent rounds despite layoffs and a major customer loss raises questions about runway, growth trajectory, and investor appetite at current operating performance.
key_risks.headline: No new funding round since 2021 Series B

key_risks.details: Sama operates in a market with heavily funded direct competitors (Scale AI, Surge AI, Labelbox, Appen, CloudFactory). Many competitors have raised significantly more recent capital and may outcompete on price, automation depth, or technical capabilities, especially as model-assisted labeling commoditizes.
key_risks.headline: Intense competition from well-capitalized peers

key_risks.details: Sama has shifted away from content moderation after years of legal battles since 2022. The Meta privacy controversy highlighted ethical and operational risks tied to content moderation work, which may deter certain enterprise buyers and complicate Sama's positioning as a 'responsible AI' partner.
key_risks.headline: Content moderation history carries reputational and legal baggage

key_risks.details: The Nairobi office previously housed over 1,100 employees serving as a primary operations hub. The mass layoff there demonstrates operational concentration risk and may impair delivery capacity for remaining customers if alternative delivery hubs (Uganda, Montréal) cannot fully backfill specialized workflows.
key_risks.headline: Geographic and operational concentration in Nairobi delivery hub

key_highlights.details: Sama's customer list includes Microsoft, Google, Walmart, NASA, Sony, Qualcomm, Continental, Getty Images, Verizon, Siemens, and SWIFT. Average customer tenure is 8 years, indicating strong relationship durability and account expansion potential.
key_highlights.headline: Blue-chip enterprise customer roster with multi-year relationships

key_highlights.details: Sama reports a 99% first-batch client acceptance rate across 10 billion annotation points per month, with up to 99.5% quality guarantee. 2024 CSAT score of 92% and NPS of 64 demonstrate sustained customer satisfaction across engagements.
key_highlights.headline: Industry-leading quality metrics at production scale

key_highlights.details: Sama operates a 4,000+ full-time in-house team (never crowdsourced), with vertically segmented industry expertise, average tenure of 2+ years, and dedicated team matching. This contrasts with typical crowdsourced annotation vendors and supports higher quality guarantees.
key_highlights.headline: Differentiated full-time in-house workforce model

key_highlights.details: Sama holds ISO 9001, ISO 27001, ISO 42001 (in progress), SOC 2 (in progress), TISAX, EU GDPR, and B Corp certifications, enabling it to serve regulated industries including automotive (TISAX), financial services (SWIFT), and global enterprise customers.
key_highlights.headline: Comprehensive enterprise-grade compliance and security posture

key_highlights.details: In 2025 alone, Sama launched Sama Automate (40% annotation time reduction, targeting 10x), Smart Review (reduces review rates from 100% to 10%), and Bulk Annotation (up to 80% faster, 25% inconsistency reduction), all combining AI automation with human-in-the-loop validation.
key_highlights.headline: Active product innovation cycle driving efficiency gains

key_highlights.details: Sama processes 300 million frames and 850 million shapes per month, with the Sama Hub project management workspace, Sama IQ analytics engine, and SamaAssure quality system providing a defensible platform layer on top of managed services.
key_highlights.headline: Sustained scale advantages with proprietary platform

customer_concentration.details: Sama's named customer logos include 15+ Fortune 500 and large enterprise accounts (Microsoft, Google, Walmart, Continental, Siemens, Qualcomm, Sony, Verizon, NASA, eBay, Getty Images, SWIFT, Bird), but the April 2026 Meta contract termination that triggered 1,108 layoffs in a single Nairobi office demonstrates that any one of these large customers can represent a single-digit to double-digit percentage of revenue. The 8-year average customer tenure and 99% first-batch acceptance rate reduce churn risk among retained accounts, yet the managed-services, multi-year enterprise contract model concentrates revenue in a relatively small number of large accounts. The recent launch of Sama Automate targeted at smaller organizations indicates management awareness of concentration risk and a deliberate diversification push. Until revenue split data becomes available, concentration should be treated as High based on the demonstrated Meta exposure and enterprise sales motion.
